current_phone_or_zp_login.accept_status: status === "success" && userId != null (not a positive-number schema check)
current_phone_or_zp_login.adoption: Only truthy accessToken is mapped to {token:accessToken,expiresIn:ttlSeconds}; other result fields remain returned data
current_phone_or_zp_login.units: seconds at TTL input; absolute deadline milliseconds
current_phone_or_zp_login.numeric_edges: No finite/positive guard in this exact fallback; numeric 0/negative/NaN/Infinity are not replaced solely by the typeof test; numeric strings fall back.
current_phone_or_zp_login.absent_access_token: No new tokenInfo is assigned by b; old token may remain. userInfo fetch still follows, possibly using cookie/raw fallback. Server semantics unknown.

header_overwrite.path: Q/S passes options.header -> Y$ keeps default options.headers Content-Type -> jt sets n.header=e.headers
header_overwrite.observed_constructed_request_effect: O1e custom headers, including any custom Authorization, are replaced at jt; interceptor may later add API Authorization/metadata.
header_overwrite.suggested_sdk_difference: Expose explicit captcha proof headers and merge them; label as repaired handling rather than exact App behavior.

captcha.sms_acceptance: After returnEnvelope, code=Number(envelope.code ?? 0); reject if finite && not 0 && not 200; generic code 4 success does not carry through this caller.
captcha.native_flow: Native page opens remote /h5/pages/auth/captcha-h5?requestId&phone&resultKey; H5 sends SMS and returns status sms_sent; parent does not send again for sms_sent.

response.envelope: non-nullish data first, then result when !==undefined, else undefined
response.first_401: HTTP statusCode==401 OR numeric envelope.code===401; occurs before returnEnvelope/business success
response.on_401: skipLoginRedirect: reject original response; else await logout then navigate and reject
response.nonnumeric_code: not rejected by generic code check
response.login_business_error: loginBizHandled creates LoginBizApiError(code, message, extracted result, raw)
response.retries: No generic retry loop; SSE JSON-401 helper returns false after initiating logout/navigation, so conditional D5e resend is not enabled by it.

boss_credentials.separation: Inbound IntroGet wt2 and IM webTicket2 are not proven equal. IM token is not API Bearer, and IM reconnect is not App access refresh.

sdk_recommendations: Implement known login paths/TTL adoption with raw response retention; surface profile/guide authorization separately from access-token presence.
Do not provide a guessed refresh endpoint. Optional externally supplied refresh adapter and local singleflight must be labeled SDK behavior.
Use an account generation and token identity around async login/refresh/401 adoption, so old completion cannot restore/clear a new account; never blindly replay non-idempotent writes.
Keep IM credentials separate and clear by account generation; do not substitute IM forceRefresh for App refresh.
Expose the captcha challenge callback contract and explicit headers; do not try to solve or synthesize proof. Remote challenge network schema is unknown.
Do not implement current wxLogin params.req expression as a proven server request body; expose opaque body or mark unsupported until another source/authorized runtime establishes it.
